messages.subject: "Didn't converge" warning.
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to analyze via R/qtl my F2 mice population. The read.cross function gives me the following output:
 
--Read the following data:
	 373  individuals
	 794  markers
	 10  phenotypes
 --Estimating genetic map
 --Cross type: f2 

Warning message:
Didn't converge!

Does anyone know the possible reason why it gives me such warning? 
I attach the obtained map picture. Is there any additional result I can post to help troubleshoot the issue? 

Thanks a lot!


Chiara

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] "Didn't converge" warning.
parts:
Estimation of the genetic map uses an iterative algorithm; the warning message says that the map estimates didn't converge to the final estimates yet.

You'll want to use est.map to get a final map, and then replace.map to plug it into the cross object.

karl
